Dhana here. It was great meeting you at {{2}}.

Quick question: After collecting business cards, how many prospects actually become customers?

Most businesses at exhibitions and events struggle with:
• Delayed follow-ups
• Poor brand recall
• Manual business card data entry
• No clear Return on Exhibition Spend (ROES)

That’s why we built Name Card Scan (NCS).

With NCS, you can:
• Scan or upload business cards
• Instantly capture contact details
• Automatically send your WhatsApp & Email introduction, digital business card, brochures (PDF) and videos
• Store all data in Google Drive
• Push leads directly to Zoho CRM via API

NCS helps you engage prospects while your brand is still fresh in their minds.

ROES = Prospect → Qualified Lead → Sale → Customer

Reply YES and let my team help you get started with NCS to improve your ROES.
